hypotheses.expect: A ground loop that finds a live one exits 0 quietly and leaves it running; --force kills the old one and takes the claim; the ground loop's lock path carries the cairn instance. The bus (clause 1 for bus.lock) and shim naming (<device>_1) are separate tickets, RULE 1.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a second ground loop started while the first is live exits 0 with nothing on stdout or stderr and leaves the first running; with --force it kills the old one and holds the claim; (2) the ground loop's lock path contains the cairn instance segment (devices/cairn/0/...), not a host-global path
hypotheses.piece: Census first: for ground_loop, bus, rack and a cc name on the bus, record what a spin-up does when a live copy exists. Then close each gap with the cairn/tools/
